t: Line focus x-ray tubes—a new concept to produce high brilliance x-rays - PMC
s: Currently hard coherent x-ray radiation at high photon fluxes can only be produced with large and expensive radiation sources, such as 3 ... d generation synchrotrons. Especially in medicine, this limitation prevents various promising developments in imaging and therapy from being translated into clinical practice. Here we present a new concept of highly brilliant x-ray sources, line focus x-ray tubes (LFXTs), which may serve as a powerful and cheap alternative to synchrotrons and a range of other existing technologies.
